description: Donor-use outcome vocabulary (selection layer v2). Orthogonal to SELECTION_RULES.json: the rules/ledgers keep deciding WHOLE-ASSET replacement (role + reason_code, unchanged and reproducible); this file defines how those results are read as outcomes and what explicit component/composite/technique use records must contain. A donor that is unsuitable as a whole-asset replacement is NOT thereby useless.

native_keep.meaning: Platinum-native asset stays as the shipped result for this group (identical, or a human keep verdict). Says nothing about component use.

direct_replacement.meaning: Whole donor asset replaces the Platinum asset (ledger role preferred).

alternate.meaning: Eligible whole-asset replacement, not the chosen one for its target.

not_selected.meaning: No use identified at selection level (irrelevant source, no independent evidence, no Platinum counterpart, below thresholds). Component review may still find use.

needs_evidence.meaning: Whole-asset verdict blocked on missing/unmeasured evidence.

technique_reference.meaning: Method/timing/staging/layout idea only; NO donor pixels or data enter the Platinum asset. Derived as a pool for technique-class groups; explicit records pin a target and a technique.

component_donor.meaning: A specific component/property of the donor asset is useful for a Platinum target. Candidate finding; not yet committed to a build plan.

composite_input.meaning: A component committed as an input of a composite plan that builds a NEW Platinum-native asset from Platinum + donor components/techniques.

legacy_role_map.comment: (role, reason_code) of a ledger decision -> derived replacement-axis outcome. The ledger needs_evidence flag (reason needs_evidence) wins over everything; control_unmeasured / weak_evidence_share are not evidence requests (control is never selectable; weak share is a curation weakness) so they read as not_selected. Every (role, reason) pair present in a ledger must resolve here (validator).

work_lanes.direct_replacement: A: whole-asset donor replacement (ledger preferred; runtime QA gated)
work_lanes.native_enhancement: B: new Platinum-native asset built from Platinum + selected donor components (composite plans)
work_lanes.technique_only: C: technique/timing/layout implemented in Platinum with no donor pixels

pixel_use.donor_pixels: donor pixels are copied into the Platinum-native result
pixel_use.recolored_donor: donor pixels copied after a palette remap
pixel_use.derived: result is redrawn/re-derived using the donor as a reference overlay; no pixel copied verbatim
pixel_use.none: technique only; nothing from the donor asset enters the result (required for technique_reference)

record_status.proposed: assessment by tooling/agent; NOT human approved; cannot be a `ready` composite input
record_status.human_confirmed: digest-bound human confirmation (human_review block bound to source member_digest, evidence digest and record content digest)
record_status.withdrawn: retained for provenance; ignored by queue

composite_status.design_pending: inputs not all human_confirmed or technique not specified
composite_status.ready: all inputs human_confirmed, native base pinned by hash; implementation (not automated compositing) may start
composite_status.implemented: reserved for after a built asset lands
